title: Cousances Cast Iron Dutch Oven No. 24 – Made in France – Vintage Enameled Casserole
description:
Beautiful vintage Cousances enameled cast iron Dutch oven, size No. 24, made in France. Cousances is the historic French cookware brand that was later acquired by Le Creuset, and these pieces are well known for their excellent craftsmanship and durability.
This classic round casserole is ideal for stews, soups, braising, roasting, and slow cooking. The heavy enameled cast iron provides excellent heat retention and even heat distribution for perfect cooking results.
Details:
• Brand: Cousances
• Type: Cast iron Dutch oven / casserole
• Size: No. 24
• Material: Enameled cast iron
• Color: Yellow exterior with light enamel interior
• Made in France
• Two side handles with matching lid
Condition:
Good vintage condition with normal signs of use. The interior enamel remains clean and well preserved. Please see photos for details.
A wonderful piece of classic French cookware, perfect for everyday cooking or for collectors of vintage Cousances / Le Creuset era cast iron.
